result.finding: Docker is used as the container engine, specifically for running the Oracle Database XE container. No Dockerfile or docker-compose.yml is present for the application itself; Docker is referenced only as a prerequisite for the Oracle database dependency.
evidence: README.md documents 'docker run' command to start Oracle Database XE container: 'docker run -d --name oracle-xe -p 1521:1521 -e ORACLE_PWD=oracle container-registry.oracle.com/database/express:latest'
README.md lists Docker as a prerequisite: 'Docker (for running Oracle database container)'
No Dockerfile, Containerfile, or docker-compose.yml found for the application itself
No CI/CD workflow files found in .github/workflows/
values: Used for Oracle Database XE container only (not for the application itself)
